description:
Analyze the DHCP packet capture file loaded in Wireshark (~/Documents/captures/dhcp.pcap). Reconstruct every DHCP lease transaction found in the capture. Create a text report at ~/Documents/captures/dhcp_analysis_report.txt. 

The report MUST follow this structure:
1. A header summarizing total packet count and unique transaction IDs.
2. A section for EACH transaction (grouped by Transaction ID/xid) containing:
   - Transaction ID (hex)
   - Client MAC address
   - Assigned IP address (Your IP/yiaddr)
   - DHCP Server IP (from option 54)
   - Lease options if present: Subnet Mask, Router, DNS Server, Lease Time.

Ensure you document ALL transactions found in the capture.
